description: Categorical gender field stored as text. The column is complete with 0 missing values across 30 records and contains 4 observed distinct values: 'Male', 'Female', 'male', and 'FEMALE'. The values indicate case-only variation for the same categories rather than additional categories.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardize case-only variations affecting 66.7% of observed distinct values to a consistent title-case format: 'male' → 'Male', 'FEMALE' → 'Female'.
